question: Which of the following quantities is measured using a torsion balance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Force.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Torsion balance** is an instrument used to measure small forces.
 
• It is based on the principle that a wire or thread resists twisting with a force that is proportional to the stress. 
 
• It is used to measure the **gravitational acceleration** at the Earth's surface.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Name**
 **Details**
 
 

 Magnetism
 
 
 
• It is the force exerted by the magnets when they attract or repel each other
 
 
 
 

 Force
 
 
 
• Force is an influence that can change the motion of the object.
 
• It can cause an object with mass to change its velocity.
 
 
 
 

 Charge
 
 
 
• It is a physical property of matter that causes an experience of force when placed in the field.
 
 
 
 

 Pressure
 
 
 
• It is the force applied perpendicular to the surface of an object per unit area over which that force is distributed.
